summary: But for me this isn't a tech issue but a critical #literacies problem. We need to support African Diaspora Art online, we need to indigenous peoples' to record and share pasts, we need safe and diverse spaces, we need more than an English only web.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: But for me this isn't a tech issue but a critical #literacies problem. We need to support African Diaspora Art online, we need to indigenous peoples' to record and share pasts, we need safe and diverse spaces, we need more than an English only web.
